disclosures: CairoFlow computer-vision output: boxes come from a detector and tracks from our procedure. It is not ground truth and no value here was measured on the road.
Every value is ungated: no registered gate has compared it with the published trajectories for this analysis.
Ground positions are approximated through a camera homography. Along-road distances from it are not accepted (ADR-018), so speed and stopped share are withheld and no per-point speed is stored.
Arms and turns are coarse junction quadrants from a track's first and last points; a track the window cut off has no exit and no turn.

Entering counts hold tracks first seen within 40 px of the image's edge or in the first 0.3 s of the window. The published reference counts every vehicle it holds, so the two definitions differ. 9 other counted tracks began mid-view (N 4, S 5). Each is either a restarted track or a queued vehicle the detector first saw moving, so they are left out of entering counts, which can then run low; they stay in the vehicle total and the turns.
Vehicle classes without a detector label are inferred from a rough placed size.

Part of this run is outside the validated window: the geometry check ran on source seconds 970-1000, which cover 30 s of this run's 60 s. Ground positions, arms and turns outside it carry no check of their own.
Footage is from Los Angeles in 2005, not Cairo. Image rows from 410 down are the window frame; points there are flagged.
2.7% of track points are still interpolated across missed detections and flagged; the parent analysis was refined by SAM 3.1, so some rows that were interpolated now carry SAM's box.
1 frame at the start of the window was not read: by the video's own clock it belongs to the held-out block before it.

SAM 3.1 was given this analysis's own tracks as box prompts in 9 requests and followed 101 of 102 tracks. It confirmed 9900 observed rows; on 60 tracks it replaced 586 interpolated rows with its own box and added 57 rows past a track's end; 127 of its rows were rejected for disagreeing with the track. Observed detector rows were not moved. Masks, boxes and object ids are model-generated, not ground truth; ids are only reliable while a vehicle stays in frame. Rows carrying a SAM box are flagged, and their confidence is SAM's, not the detector's. A vehicle no track reached is still absent: SAM follows only what it was given. Track lengths and widths come from SAM masks on 98 tracks: the smallest rectangle round a mask's ground outline, median over masks the image did not cut off. They are approximated, on a flat-road homography whose along-road distances are not accepted (ADR-018). 5 tracks take their class from that length by the reference's length bands, with class source sam; the evidence for this rests on very few long vehicles.
